'''Mee'r''' was the most populated of the three continents on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Draenell's Point]]. The [[West Unillian Mountains]] was located on the continent, as well as five major [[City/Legends|cities]]; the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Wullerton]]; the civilian [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], [[Starpoint (city)|Starpoint]]; [[Jhepar]], [[Thulpin City]], and [[Uniqer]]. The continent's population numbered twenty-nine million. Five million lived in Wullerton, three million in Starpoint, and one million each in Jhepar, Thulpin City, and Uniqer.
